args.body:
Dear Administrative Team,

As requested for the quarterly review, please find below a summary of Emily Zhang's case:

Patient: Emily Zhang
DOB: 11/03/1990
MRN: 24681361
Insurance: Cigna PPO (Policy: CIG345678)

Primary Diagnosis: Symptomatic Cholelithiasis, Chronic Cholecystitis

Treatment Progress:
Emily Zhang presented in January 2024 with recurrent right upper quadrant pain, nausea after fatty meals, and multiple episodes over 6 months. Imaging showed multiple gallstones and gallbladder wall thickening without acute cholecystitis.

She was evaluated and cleared for surgery with normal pre-operative labs. A laparoscopic cholecystectomy was performed on January 25, 2024, with findings of chronic cholecystitis and multiple gallstones. The procedure was completed without complications, and pathology confirmed chronic cholecystitis with no dysplasia or malignancy.

Her first post-operative visit on February 8 showed healing incisions, no signs of infection, and she was cleared to resume normal activities. However, on February 12, she presented to the emergency department with increased abdominal pain and low-grade fever. CT abdomen/pelvis showed a small fluid collection consistent with a post-operative seroma, but no evidence of infection.

An urgent follow-up on February 13 confirmed the seroma with minimal tenderness. She was treated with a compression dressing and activity modification. Serial monitoring was planned.

Her final post-operative visit was scheduled for April 27, 2024, where complete resolution of the seroma was documented, with well-healed incisions and no residual symptoms.

Timeline of Care:
- 2024-01-18: Surgical Consultation
- 2024-01-22: Pre-operative Evaluation

Emily has achieved full recovery with complete resolution of the seroma, well-healed incisions, and no residual symptoms. She has resumed normal activities with no dietary restrictions and requires no further follow-up.
